mapper.sql: SELECT uco.cert_code, MAX(NULLIF(uco.competition_name, '')) AS local_contest_name, MAX(NULLIF(uco.user_name, '')) AS local_name, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(csi.competition_series, ''), NULLIF(csi.competition_series_name, ''))) AS local_session, MAX(CASE WHEN uco.year REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(uco.year AS UNSIGNED) END) AS local_year FROM user_certificate_origin uco LEFT JOIN competition_series_info csi ON csi.competition_series_id = uco.competition_series_id WHERE uco.del_flag = '0' AND uco.cert_code IS NOT NULL AND uco.cert_code != '' AND uco.team_code IS NOT NULL AND uco.team_code != '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM competition_apply_info cai WHERE cai.competition_series_id = uco.competition_series_id AND cai.team_code = uco.team_code AND cai.leader_teacher_id = #{userId} AND cai.pay_status = 'paid' AND cai.del_flag = '0' ) GROUP BY uco.cert_code
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO certificate_image_cache (cert_code, contest_name, recipient_name, session, runing_num_year, cache_status, retry_count, create_time, update_time) SELECT uco.cert_code, MAX(NULLIF(uco.competition_name, '')), MAX(NULLIF(uco.user_name, '')), MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(csi.competition_series, ''), NULLIF(csi.competition_series_name, ''))), MAX(CASE WHEN uco.year REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(uco.year AS UNSIGNED) END), 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), NOW() FROM user_certificate_origin uco LEFT JOIN competition_series_info csi ON csi.competition_series_id = uco.competition_series_id WHERE uco.del_flag = '0' AND uco.cert_code IS NOT NULL AND uco.cert_code != '' AND uco.team_code IS NOT NULL AND uco.team_code != '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM competition_apply_info cai WHERE cai.competition_series_id = uco.competition_series_id AND cai.team_code = uco.team_code AND cai.leader_teacher_id IS NOT NULL AND cai.pay_status = 'paid' AND cai.del_flag = '0' ) GROUP BY uco.cert_code

INSERT IGNORE INTO certificate_image_cache (cert_code, contest_name, recipient_name, session, runing_num_year, cache_status, retry_count, create_time, update_time) SELECT source.cert_code, source.local_contest_name, source.local_name, source.local_session, source.local_year, 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), NOW() FROM () source
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cache.contest_name, source.local_contest_name) value FROM () source LEFT JOIN certificate_image_cache cache ON cache.cert_code = source.cert_code WHERE COALESCE(cache.contest_name, source.local_contest_name) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY value

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cache.session, source.local_session) value FROM () source LEFT JOIN certificate_image_cache cache ON cache.cert_code = source.cert_code WHERE COALESCE(cache.session, source.local_session) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY value

SELECT DISTINCT cache.contest_area value FROM () source JOIN certificate_image_cache cache ON cache.cert_code = source.cert_code WHERE cache.contest_area IS NOT NULL AND cache.contest_area != '' ORDER BY value

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cache.runing_num_year, source.local_year) value FROM () source LEFT JOIN certificate_image_cache cache ON cache.cert_code = source.cert_code WHERE COALESCE(cache.runing_num_year, source.local_year) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT source.cert_code FROM () source WHERE source.cert_code IN #{code} ORDER BY source.cert_code
SELECT source.cert_code FROM () source ORDER BY source.cert_code
SELECT * FROM certificate_image_cache WHERE cert_code = #{certCode}

SELECT * FROM certificate_image_cache WHERE cache_status != 'SUCCESS' AND cache_status != 'SYNCING' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY FIELD(cache_status, 'PENDING', 'FAILED', 'NOT_FOUND'), cache_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM certificate_image_cache WHERE cache_status != 'SUCCESS' AND cache_status != 'SYNCING' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM certificate_image_cache WHERE cache_status IN ('PENDING', 'SYNCING')

SELECT * FROM certificate_image_cache
AND cert_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.certCode}, '%')
AND recipient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%')
AND contest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contestName}, '%')
AND contest_area LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contestArea}, '%')
AND cache_status = #{query.cacheStatus}
ORDER BY cache_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(cache_status = 'SUCCESS') AS successCount, SUM(cache_status = 'PENDING') AS pendingCount, SUM(cache_status = 'SYNCING') AS syncingCount, SUM(cache_status = 'NOT_FOUND') AS notFoundCount, SUM(cache_status = 'FAILED') AS failedCount FROM certificate_image_cache
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET cache_status = 'SYNCING', update_time = NOW() WHERE cert_code = #{certCode} AND cache_status != 'SUCCESS' AND cache_status != 'SYNCING' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW())
UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET cache_status = 'PENDING', update_time = NOW() WHERE cert_code = #{certCode} AND cache_status = 'SYNCING'

UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET contest_name = COALESCE(#{contestName}, contest_name), recipient_name = COALESCE(#{name}, recipient_name), session = COALESCE(#{session}, session), contest_area = COALESCE(#{contestArea}, contest_area), runing_num_year = COALESCE(#{runingNumYear}, runing_num_year), object_key = #{objectKey}, file_name = #{fileName}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, sha256 = #{sha256}, cache_status = 'SUCCESS', retry_count = 0, last_error = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, last_sync_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE cert_code = #{certCode}

UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET contest_name = COALESCE(#{contestName}, contest_name), recipient_name = COALESCE(#{name}, recipient_name), session = COALESCE(#{session}, session), contest_area = COALESCE(#{contestArea}, contest_area), runing_num_year = COALESCE(#{runingNumYear}, runing_num_year), cache_status = 'NOT_FOUND', retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_sync_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE cert_code = #{certCode}

UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET cache_status = 'FAILED', retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_sync_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE cert_code = #{certCode}
UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET cache_status = 'PENDING', update_time = NOW() WHERE cache_status = 'SYNCING' AND update_time < #{staleBefore}
UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET cache_status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, last_error = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE cache_status IN ('FAILED', 'NOT_FOUND')
UPDATE certificate_image_cache SET cache_status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, last_error = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE cert_code = #{certCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO certificate_image_sync_run (source, run_status, total_count, processed_count, success_count, failure_count, requests_per_second, operator_id, operator_name, start_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{source}, #{runStatus}, #{totalCount}, #{processedCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{requestsPerSecond}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{startTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate_image_sync_run SET run_status = #{runStatus}, total_count = #{totalCount}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, current_cert_code = #{currentCertCode}, last_error = #{lastError}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM certificate_image_sync_run WHERE run_status IN ('RUNNING', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM certificate_image_sync_run ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM certificate_image_sync_run WHERE run_id = #{runId}
SELECT * FROM certificate_image_sync_run ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate_image_sync_run SET run_status = 'PAUSED', update_time = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE certificate_image_sync_run SET run_status = 'RUNNING', update_time = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'PAUSED'
UPDATE certificate_image_sync_run SET run_status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{message}, end_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE run_status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO certificate_export_task (task_id, user_id, export_scope, selected_cert_codes, task_status, phase, progress, total_count, processed_count, success_count, failure_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{exportScope}, #{selectedCertCodes}, #{taskStatus}, #{phase}, #{progress}, #{totalCount}, #{processedCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate_export_task SET task_status = #{taskStatus}, phase = #{phase}, progress = #{progress}, total_count = #{totalCount}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, zip_object_key = #{zipObjectKey}, zip_file_name = #{zipFileName}, missing_cert_codes = #{missingCertCodes}, last_error = #{lastError}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM certificate_export_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT * FROM certificate_export_task WHERE task_status IN ('QUEUED', 'RESOLVING', 'PACKAGING', 'UPLOADING') ORDER BY create_time LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate_export_task SET task_status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
